Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 szChkDgt varchar2(3);
 
 CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT rownum, u.unit_id, u.coll_date unit_coll_date ,d.coll_date don_coll_date,
 d.donation_type, d.procedure_code
 FROM units u, donations d
 WHERE u.unit_id = d.unit_id
 AND u.coll_date != d.coll_date
 AND u.coll_date between :control_blk.from_date and :control_blk.to_date
 AND d.coll_date between :control_blk.from_date and :control_blk.to_date
 AND u.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 and d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
BEGIN 
 message('Working...'); --pitss synchronize;
 CLEAR_MESSAGE;
 IF (:control_blk.to_date - :control_blk.from_date) > :control_blk.no_of_days THEN
 GO_ITEM('CONTROL_BLK.TO_DATE');
 show_error('1707',' of days. Date difference is more than CDIFF parameter value '||:control_blk.no_of_days); 
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 GO_BLOCK('UNITS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 
 FOR C1_REC IN C1
 LOOP
 /*diptiia added for ISBT check igit */ 
 if length(C1_REC.unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(C1_REC.unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :UNITS.unit_id:=C1_REC.unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else
 :UNITS.unit_id := C1_REC.unit_id;
 end if;
 
 :UNITS.SEQ_NO := C1_REC.rownum;
 --:UNITS.unit_id := C1_REC.unit_id;
 :UNITS.unit_coll_date := C1_REC.unit_coll_date;
 :UNITS.don_coll_date := C1_REC.don_coll_date;
 :UNITS.donation_type := C1_REC.donation_type;
 :UNITS.procedure_code := C1_REC.procedure_code;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 IF :units.seq_no is NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM('CONTROL_BLK.from_date');
 SHOW_ERROR('11091');
 Check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 DISABLE_CONTROL_BLK;
 END IF;
END ;

procedure start_report_gen is
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 batch_queue rpt_report_names.batch_queue%type;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);

Begin

 begin
 select parameter_value into rep_dir from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'REPOUTPUT' and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 exception

 when others then
 message('REPSOURCE parameter not defined: Contact IS');pause;
 end;

 filename := rep_dir||'DRRCOLLD'||'_'||to_char(sysdate,'mmddyyhh24mi')||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.r';

 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 end; 

 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'FILE');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,filename) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESFORMAT',TEXT_PARAMETER,'Wide');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.r_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(:global.chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,'Y');
 rp2rro.rp2rro_run_product(REPORTS,'DRRCOLLD',ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 
End ;
